describes the ways we can use the information we collect when you create a profile. For example, we use this information to provide, personalize and improve our products.

By using this app you agree to these terms.

You must be at least 13 years old to create an account. You are responsible for the content you post and for keeping your password secure.

Do not post content that is unlawful, hateful, harassing or that infringes someone else's rights. We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these rules.

You can delete your account at any time from Settings.

This app is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to InstaNova or Meta.

This privacy policy describes the information we collect and how we use it.

We collect the details you give us when you create a profile: your email address, birthday, name and username. We also store the photos, videos, comments and messages you choose to share.

We use this information to provide, personalize and improve our products, to keep the community safe, and to recommend people and content you may find relevant.

We do not sell your personal information. You can review and change your profile details at any time from Settings, and you can delete your account at any time.

This app is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to InstaNova or Meta.

Cookies and similar technologies keep you signed in and help us understand how the app is used.

We use them to remember your session so you do not have to log in every time you open the app, and to measure which features are used so we can improve them.

You can clear these at any time by logging out, which removes the stored session from this device.

This app is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to InstaNova or Meta.

Next, allow access or skip these steps. You can change these settings anytime. If you already have %1$s on your device, some settings may have been turned on previously.

SMS notifications let us send you security alerts and login codes. You can turn them off at any time from the settings on your device, and you can change how we contact you later from Settings in the app.
Why do I need to provide my birthday?

We use your birthday to make sure you are old enough to use the app, and to give you the right experience for your age. It is not shown on your profile, and no one else can see it. You can change it later from your profile.

When this is on, we keep your login on this device so you stay signed in the next time you open the app. When it is off, you will need to log in again each time. Use the off setting on a shared device.
This app does not read or upload your contacts. The row on the previous screen is part of the design only, and no contact data ever leaves your device. Nothing is synced to our servers.

A username is how people find and mention you. It can contain lowercase letters, numbers, full stops and underscores, and must be between 3 and 30 characters. You can change it at any time from your profile.

You are signed in, but this account has no InstaNova profile. If you used InstaNova before the account system changed, your posts, followers and messages are still stored — they are not deleted. Linking an older profile to this sign-in has to be verified, so it cannot happen automatically. Retry if you have just created your profile, or sign out and sign in with the account you used to create one.

This account signed in successfully, but it is not yet provisioned for InstaNova\'s database, so saving likes, follows and posts will be rejected. This is a server-side setting that the app cannot create. If you just registered, retry in a moment; otherwise contact support or sign out.
InstaNova could not reach its server. Your session is still valid — check your connection and retry.
